info.title: invoicd — INVOIC check and settlement
info.description: The § 147 AO receipt register of every INVOIC a market partner sent, the answers it was given, the statements that decide a held invoice, and the webhook routes for the events invoicd emits.

200.description: Receipts whose outcome is Dispute, newest first

get.summary:
The service's events within the retention window, in commit order — the
feed an integrator polls instead of, or beside, an endpoint. Each item is
the CloudEvent as delivered.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: A `mako_events::matches` pattern (`de.mako.vertrag.*`); every type when absent.

post.description:
Record that the MSB performed — or did not perform — an ordered Leistung
for an Artikel-ID over a period: Prüfschritt 310 for every position it
covers. Every invoice of that MSB held on that order walks again at once;
one recorded before its invoice arrives is read when it does.

requestBody.description: `Leistungsnachweis`: Rechnungssteller, Bestellung, Artikel-ID, period, whether it was performed, and the Nachweis

201.description: Recorded; every held invoice of that order walked again (`erneut_geprueft`)

get.description:
Receipts whose Zahlungsziel is within three days and whose answer never went
out. An undispatched answer past the Zahlungsziel is both a market-process
breach and a § 147 AO gap, so this is the alert query: run it every 6 h and
alert when it is non-empty.

200.description: `count` and `items`: receipts within three days of their Zahlungsziel whose answer never went out

404.description: No such receipt in this tenant

post.description:
The ERP reports that the money moved. Closes the § 147 AO payment trail and
stops the receipt appearing in the overdue view.

404.description: No such receipt, or it was confirmed already

post.description:
Re-send the market answer for a receipt whose automatic dispatch failed.

The routing key, the command and the payload all come from the receipt:

- **The routing key** is the EDIFACT message reference, which is what
  `makod` correlates the answer by.
- **The command** is the answering PID's, from [`crate::routing`].
- **The payload** is the one recorded at the check — Antwortcode, EBD,
  Befunde and Ablehnungsgrund — so the REMADV states what the automatic
  answer would have.

Getting either wrong fails silently — `makod` accepts the command and only
the correlation misses — so neither is defaulted.

200.description: The answer command was accepted by makod

404.description: No such receipt in this tenant

422.description: The receipt has no answer to send

502.description: makod did not accept the command

post.description:
State the answers a held invoice's walk could not read — Prüfschritt 310
(Leistung erbracht), 320 (Preis wie Angebot), 330 (Steuersatz) per
Positionsnummer, and 80 (Preisblatt-Version) — and walk it again in place.
A walk that now reaches a verdict is answered and announced as an
automatic one would be; one still open names what is missing. `409` when
the receipt is not held.

requestBody.description: `FeststellungBody`: the stated Prüfschritt answers and the Begründung

200.description: The receipt walked again; `outcome` is its result

409.description: The receipt is not held for a statement

422.description: No Begründung, or no Prüfschritt stated

200.description: The BO4E Rechnung exactly as received, with its BO4E version and PID

404.description: No such receipt in this tenant

post.description:
Record that a dispute was settled out of band (a corrected invoice, a phone
call, a COMDIS). Moves `Dispute` → `Resolved` with the caller as the
decider and the operator's note. No market message goes out: the answer
REMADV was sent when the dispute was raised.

requestBody.description: An optional note on how the dispute was settled

204.description: Dispute → Resolved, with the caller as decider

post.summary:
Queue every event of a time window again for one endpoint, including
events that never had a delivery to it.

Rotate the secret: the new one signs from now, the previous one beside it
for `overlap_hours`. The answer shows the new secret once.
Send `de.mako.webhook.test` to the endpoint now, signed like a delivery.
